__comment: SINGLE SOURCE for retired Axiomancer terminology AND retired design-law prose. scripts/check-lexicon.mjs (repo root) enforces this registry against every live prose surface in CI; docs/LEXICON.md is the human-readable mirror with the canonical-terms guide. To retire a concept: add a row here, run the lint, fix what it flags — that IS the cleanup. Two row shapes: type "identifier" (the default when the field is absent) matches a term line-by-line; type "doctrine" matches a multi-clause design-law CLAIM against the whole file with whitespace collapsed, so a sentence wrapped across markdown line breaks is still caught. Doctrine patterns are ASSERTION-scoped by construction — a file that names a retired law in order to call it retired must not be a finding, or every reconciliation the lint asks for would create a new one. Patterns are JS regexes (case-sensitive unless the pattern says otherwise); doctrine patterns are authored against single-space prose. Legitimate mentions of a retired term or law (e.g. "basePower no longer exists") stay allowed via a file-level pragma: <!-- lexicon-ok: <id>, <id> -->. Files whose head carries "**Status:** HISTORICAL" are dated records and exempt entirely.
